title: FizzShare
subtitle: Peer-to-Peer File Sharing over WebRTC
description: Browser-to-browser file transfer where the server only relays signaling and mints time-limited TURN credentials — the file bytes travel directly between devices over SCTP/DTLS/ICE with SHA-256 integrity verification, QR share links, and a live network inspector showing candidate pairs, RTT, and packet loss.
